Hi all,
I've formalized a spectral reduction blueprint inspired by the Hilbert–Pólya approach in Lean 4 (Mathlib v4.34.0), and analyzed its informational content:

  • Proved that the scalar bridge assumption is equivalent to RH (bridge_iff_riemann_hypothesis).

  • Formalized genuine symmetric/unbounded operator formulations where realness of eigenvalues is proved, not assumed.

  • Constructed an explicit diagonal model showing that an abstract existential realization is equivalent to RH itself (Nonempty HilbertPolyaRealization ↔ RiemannHypothesis), illustrating that the actual content remains the identification of a concrete arithmetic operator.

  • Connected the critical-strip definition to Mathlib's RiemannHypothesis.

Code & reproduction logs (sorry-free):
• GitHub: https://github.com/frostynumeral/hilbert-polya-lean-verification
• Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/22872833

Feedback on the formalization is welcome!
